content: We can also observe that the original posters tend to ask more questions than the commenting posters – 19.83% for posts vs. 11.21% for comments (summed). This suggests that the original posters frequently ask either for suggestion or confirmation of their points of view or their disconfirmation. However, the high presence of personal experiences is supported by the high number of posts containing only statements.
